original_context_note: Candidate 18 was compared with target-selection.json/full_target and material-001.md:8-41: spec.full_target preserves the complete selected text exactly. H001-H003 are precisely T>0, 0<gamma<=1, R>0, with origins at problem.md:88 and the selected statement. The real/mean-zero H^gamma datum, radius bound, positive integer step count and tau=T/L restriction remain inside the final universal conditional assertion, after the common C,tau_0 are chosen; none is omitted or promoted from a desired conclusion. D001-D008 preserve normalized measure, Fourier/Sobolev and homogeneous norms, phase sign, projections and both inverse derivatives. D009-D011 preserve every coefficient and endpoint expression of the fixed unfiltered scheme, particularly material-001.md:29-33 and 1/(27*tau). D013-D015 preserve the covariance, phases and cubic multiplier of material-001.md:46-54; polynomial/smooth definitions precede the proved Sobolev extension in N004. D016-D022 explicitly define the negative exponent, X, B,J,Ctri, stage and interpolation; they grant no residual estimate or endpoint identity. D023 is the equation/solution convention, not an assumed solution. Types and D dependencies are acyclic; no object is selected before an unproved guard. N001 proves the needed existence rather than hiding it in a definition. Source E001-E002 were checked in Babin-Ilyin-Titi arXiv:0910.1389v2 (23 October 2010, 42 pages), including Sections 3-6 and the complete relevant theorem context; E003-E006 were checked in the cited Li-Wu 50-page FoCM-3.pdf author edition, including norms, Proposition 3.4, Lemma 7.2, (2.2)-(2.3), (1.4), (4.15)-(4.23), (5.2)-(5.4). Their actual PDF/text/access evidence is hash-bound in each source record. R001 proves the reflection/sign and homogeneous-to-inhomogeneous bridges, and R006 proves the sqrt(2*pi) norm conversion and time-shift bridge. No source deferral remains and no logarithmic convergence theorem is imported. The actual AND graph has one producer for each N and P, no cycle, no unused original H, and all 12 units lie in the target's backward closure. The route matches material-001.md:55-204: covariance, two frequency majorants, dyadic summation, mixed remainder including exponent zero, interpolation, stages, actual residual, low/high stability, bootstrap and fixed-step density. Independent numerical experiments and experimental commentary in problem.md:647-817 are omitted because they do not establish the selected theorem or enter its proof route. This is a same-author mathematical closing inspection under the shared contract, distinct from structural validation and independent Audit A.
